outcome: Plasma concentrations of short-chain fatty acids (formic acid, acetic acid, propionic acid, isovaleric acid)
cohort: The study included 233 children and adults with ADHD and 36 family-related healthy controls.
finding: Adults with ADHD exhibited lower plasma concentrations of formic, acetic, propionic, and succinic acid compared to their healthy family members, with overall lower plasma SCFA levels in ADHD patients being partly attributable to antibiotic medication, age, and stimulant medication.
